x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances of 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-27, rendered in EARS; the requirements carry no scope the words do not. Full statement: engineering-services-section/content/text/documents/articles/notes/2026/10/10/2026-10-10-note-on-the-consolidation-directives-of-september-2026.md

board-opening.need: Each suite of capabilities lives in one engineering application, and a site is an instance of an application pointed at content.

requirements.says: The engineering section shall hold exactly one application for each suite of capabilities.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "truly, one application for each suite of capabilities, no divergent, duplicate, parallel systems".

requirements.says: A website served from the Group's content shall be configured by one variable that points at its content directory.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "This should legit be one config variable, pointing to content."

requirements.says: The L-Space instance shall be a GEODE instance hosted by MetroPlat as an app.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-27: "MetroPlat is meant to host L-Space as an app. L-Space is meant to be a GEODE instance."

requirements.says: The L-Space instance shall offer Google login.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-26: "L-Space doesn't have an option for Google login, it should".

requirements.says: The L-Space instance shall keep its caches and data stores within what its content needs.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-26, of 2.4 GB: "L-SPace should not be 2.4gb".

requirements.says: The CAIRN application shall hold its archive in the admitted content and carry no SQLite store.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-25: "I don't know why CAIRN has a sqlite store".

requirements.says: Each application's main name shall state what it is, with its acronym carried as its brand name.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-21: "we do like the acronym names as like brand names ... just not the main name".

requirements.says: The computer-systems apps directory shall hold only applications that compose computer-networking, computer-code and computer-data capabilities into systems.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-22: data, then code, then networking, then systems, so that there is one set of code for each job.

conditions.says: The apps directory of computer-systems holds computer-system-engine, computer-system-platform and phoss-in-a-box.
